_comment: Explicit dispositions for Scryfall census paths NOT covered by an smtg:sourceField annotation. disposition ∈ excluded | deferred | derived | raw. Everything else is computed from the ontology by tools/map/build-mapping.mjs.

object.note: JSON object-type discriminator (always "card"); carries no domain information.

all_parts[].name.note: Denormalised copy of the related printing's name; recoverable from the related object.

all_parts[].type_line.note: Denormalised copy of the related printing's type line.

all_parts[].uri.note: API URL of the related printing; recoverable from its id.

image_updated_at.note: Image freshness timestamp; candidate provenance attribute of DigitalImage (new field vs. older Scryfall docs).

preview.note: Spoiler/preview provenance (source, date); candidate Claim 'previewed by' — RQ to be opened.

purchase_uris.note: Commercial outbound links; an ExternalResourceLink pattern is not designed yet (RQ-PR-2).

related_uris.note: Outbound links (Gatherer, EDHREC, TCGplayer articles); ExternalResourceLink pattern pending.

resource_id.note: Undocumented Scryfall field observed in 2026 data; semantics to be verified before mapping (schema drift).

attraction_lights.note: Unfinity attraction lights; to be modelled as a face characteristic.
